from_quote: The Constitution in direct terms gives an appellate jurisdiction to the Supreme Court in all the enumerated cases of federal cognizance in which it is not to have an original one
rationale: Names the Constitution's grant of "appellate jurisdiction to the Supreme Court" in the enumerated cases where it has no original one, the grant made in this clause.
to_quote: In all the other Cases before mentioned, the supreme Court shall have appellate Jurisdiction

from_quote: it then proceeds to enumerate the cases to which this judicial power shall extend
rationale: Following the plan through in order, the paragraph names the next clause as the one that will "enumerate the cases to which this judicial power shall extend," echoing its words "The judicial Power shall extend."
to_quote: The judicial Power shall extend to all Cases

from_quote: It afterwards divides the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court into original and appellate
rationale: Following the plan through in order, the paragraph names the clause that "divides the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court into original and appellate."
